annotations.title: Find jobs few companies do well

description: Use cases agents bring to each category (from first-hand user accounts) with how many companies fully fit, fit with a limit, or only carry the capability tag. Use it to find under-served jobs and capabilities, or to see who does a job and how well. Default: fewest full fits first. view=capabilities lists capability ids with the companies that have each. Filters: competition (none, one, few, crowded), maxCompanies, minWeight (a use case's share of its category, 0 to 100), category, area, capability (an id or prefix), q (words). Draft readings from public docs, not yet reviewed by a person.

capability.description: A capability id or prefix, e.g. web.scrape or payments.

competition.description: How many companies fully fit: none, one, few (2 or 3), crowded (4 or more)

maxCompanies.description: At most this many companies with a full fit (with view=capabilities: with the tag)

minWeight.description: Only use cases at least this large a share of their category's work

q.description: Words that must all appear in the use case's name, asks, category or capabilities

sort.description: open (fewest full fits, then most demand; the default), demand, or crowded
